text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"‘Hey, Mom!
Did you get my package?
It's full of goods you can only get in Japan—’"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Nothing's arrived...?
I sent it weeks ago, though!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's weird~...
I'll go look into it real quick!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And here I wanted Mom and Dad to be happy~
Guess I'll have to send it again... Che.
